correctness.rationale: Using the arXiv:2311.07522 Proposition 4.1 full vertex list, full Frobenius Gram products are calculated in RESULT.md. Every max/min argument handles the disjoint star-star, star-block and block-block cases. Crossing blocks have two exclusive regions giving a lower bound by one-step products; nested block extrema reduce to one-step increments. The star-block minimum is uniquely obtained by monotonicity. The order-five crossover follows from an explicit positive cubic and exact low-order comparisons. The package verify.py independently constructs exact rational matrices, checks Monge inequalities, and compares every vertex pair and equality set in orders 2 through 12; all pass. Generality rests on algebraic proof, not finite verification.

value.rationale: The full symmetric Monge simplex models normalized Monge transport/tour cost matrices. Frobenius distance is the natural unweighted matrix error norm, so minimum and maximum vertex separation are canonical metric quantities rather than chosen slices. The theorem identifies distinct governing edge families at the two extremes, an exact dimension-five nearest-family crossover, all equality-pair counts, and the sharp diameter/min-edge growth law. Its new mixed-family information is not subsumed by the previously known hollow-only minimum formula. No general approximation guarantee or larger theorem is claimed.
